propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui nos hodierna die Exaltationis sanctae Crucis annua solemnitate
laetificas: praesta, quaesumus; ut, cujus mysterium in terra cognovimus,
ejus redemptionis praemia in caelo mereamur. Per eundem Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Adesto nobis, Domine Deus noster: et, quos sanctae Crucis laetari facis
honore, ejus quoque perpetuis defende subsidiis. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum, Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Own-appointment historical witness. Complete petitions agree under declared typography only; actual Latin conclusions are prefixes of the same own-book family through-our-lord, with person God the Father.
